// about

A teacher first, a researcher by habit

I graduated in Special Education from the Institute of Education and Research, University of Dhaka. My work moves between the classroom, the debate podium and the research field — teaching hard-of-hearing students, training in-service teachers, and collecting data for a UNICEF-funded study on continuous professional development.

Outside coursework, I organise and compete in debate, and I'm drawn to public speaking as a way of thinking out loud. I'm now looking toward graduate study abroad to sharpen my research footing.
